latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of split-drive-coach skill.

- Helps split large partitions into system, data, and backup layouts without data loss.
- Focuses on preserving existing files while creating new partitions, ideal for new PCs with a single oversized partition.
- Includes pre-flight checks, guided commands, and troubleshooting for safe partition editing.
- Provides clear install and launch instructions with both script and manual options.
- Designed for Windows 10+ using EaseUS Partition Master.
